relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: in vitro stimulation of periosteal cells with 10−10 M CGRP led to a 10-fold increase in cAMP levels after 5 min

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Stimulation with 10−10 and 10−8 M CGRP led to increased cell number relative to the vehicle-treated control.

relationships.subject: Olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed a 22% reduction in callus volume (Fig. 6b) and a 21% reduction bone mass in BIBN-4096-treated femurs compared to placebo-treated controls

relationships.subject: CLR
relationships.evidence_quote: Deletion of CLR within αSMA osteoprogenitors led to an impairment to fracture healing observed in both sexes

relationships.subject: Olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological CGRP-CLR inhibition was achieved by subcutaneous delivery of customized pellets with small molecule inhibitor olcegepant (BIBN-4096)

key_findings: Periosteal osteoprogenitors lie near CGRP+ nerves, express Calcrl/Ramp1 and proliferate with cAMP activation upon CGRP.
CLR deletion in αSMA osteoprogenitors or systemic olcegepant impairs fracture healing (22% smaller callus volume, weaker calluses).
